title: Bi-Lipschitz invariance of Newton polygons along gradient canyons
summary: We study bi-Lipschitz right-equivalence of holomorphic function germs $f:(\mathbb{C}^2,0)\to(\mathbb{C},0)$ via polar arcs and gradient canyons. For a polar arc $γ$ we consider the Newton polygon of $f_x(X+γ(Y),Y)$ and define its augmentation by adjoining the point $(0,\operatorname{ord} f(γ(y),y)-1)$. We prove that the resulting augmented Newton polygon is constant along each gradient canyon of degree $>1$ and is invariant under bi-Lipschitz right-equivalence.
